newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel's August industrial exports up 2.7 pct.
newsitem.headline: Israel's August industrial exports up 2.7 pct.

text.p: Israel's industrial exports including diamonds in August totalled $1.211 billion, a rise of 2.7 percent from a year earlier, the Industry and Trade Ministry said on Wednesday.
Exports of polished diamonds were up 10.4 percent at $202 million.

Exports of electronic components, office machines, rubber and plastic, telecommunications and medical equipment and metals all rose in August. Exports in other sectors fell, especially in the areas of chemicals and textiles.
The ministry said August's figures could not be compared with earlier months such as July because August traditionally is a slow month due to summer holidays.
In the first eight months of the year industrial exports rose 4.8 percent from the year-earlier period to $11.045 billion.
Exports of polished diamonds grew only 1.5 percent during this period to $2.641 billion.
